ITEM 1 | Orange roasted vegetable pieces, cut into rounded wedges and half-moon slices about 2-4 cm across and 1 cm thick, with darker charred spots and blackened edges, glossy surface with slight oil sheen, firm and holding shape, spread in a loose cluster covering roughly 20% of the plate in the upper-middle area | 110

ITEM 2 | Two small orange slices with dark roasted spots, one partially under the cluster, about 2 cm across, firm, slightly glossy, sitting near the lower-middle of the plate | 12

ITEM 3 | Golden-brown cooked meat-like portion, two pieces stacked side by side, roughly 8 cm long and 3-4 cm wide and 2 cm thick, with browned crust, slightly fibrous grainy texture, some pale flecks, moist-looking, holding shape, covering about 8% of the plate in the lower-center | 120

ITEM 4 | Small crumbs of light tan material, about 0.5 cm each, scattered beside the meat portion on the plate | 2
